skyblockMenuMessage: Type !sb <command> to run a skyblock related command and !sb cmds to see a list of options.
staffOnlyMessage: [ERROR] You do not have permission to run this command! If you believe this to be an error, try running the command from Minecraft chat.
inactivityInfoMessage: We recognise that nobody can be active 24/7. If and when you take a break, please let us know in the #inactivity channel in our discord.
broadcasts: Don't forget to join our guild discord! Do /g discord to receive the invite link.
